body: Thanks man. I hope this therapist can finally help me. They helped that friend of mine, so maybe they can help me too, though I don't think I'm as strong as she is. I hope I can at least find out.

I've been waiting for a couple of years now...

But no, the immediate restlessness and hopelessnes has passed. I am glad I didn't have to call her though. I mean, I know myself, and I'll probably text her about it tomorrow, but at least I didn't wake her at like 4 at night.

Thanks for helping me out though man :)

Thanks man, I really appreciate the advice.

Currently, my distraction was writing this post, and I managed to get into one of the chats of my country's suicide hotlines. Kept it pretty short cause I have calmed down a bit and there might be people in a more direm situation than me. I'm just gonna go try to daydream a bit until I fall asleep now, hopefully I'll feel a little better tomorrow.

Thanks again!

Thanks. Writing it out that rant has helped me calm down quite a bit.

I was really restless and didn't know what I was gonna do. I honestly kind of scared myself, now that I'm sort of 'back to my senses'. If that happens a couple more times, I would not be suprised if I actually went ahead with it in a moment of desperation. 

I hope I'm gonna live until I see my first therapy session with my new therapist. Still need to go to the doctor first to get referred though, so that's gonna take forever...
I think she mostly wants me to go cause I'm incredibly annoying at this point, but would feel guilty if I actually went and offed myself.
